start_nodes.description: Details of the start nodes. This is the IP address that the ION device uses as a starting point for network and device discovery.

ipv4_address.description: The IPv4 address used as the starting point for network and device discovery.

scope.description: Subnet scopes. A maximum of eight subnets can be entered per start node. This limits the discovery to a set of devices within the specified scope.

ipv4_prefix.description: The prefix of the IPv4 address.

tags.description: A information field that can be added to start nodes. Maximum 10 unique tags of length 1024 each are allowed.

body.description: Details of the Device ID start network node config to be updated
